description: Splines: paths through points shown as roads, rivers, walls or pipes; sample points along them
name: spline

tools.description: A spline through world points (smooth or linear, open or closed loop), optionally shown as a swept mesh: ribbon (road, path, river), wall or tube. Undoable.

closed.description: Closed loop (an area for pcg.scatter mode inside)

follow_ground.description: Drop each point onto the ground below

linear.description: Straight segments instead of a smooth curve

profile.description: Mesh along the spline: {kind: ribbon|wall|tube|none, width cm, height cm (ribbon thickness / wall height / tube lift), step cm, z_offset cm, plus builder material fields: material, color, roughness, metallic, emissive, opacity, variation, tile, relief}

tools.name: spline.create

tools.description: Points along a spline every `spacing` cm, with direction and yaw (for placing things in scripts).
tools.name: spline.sample
